name: Last Accounting Company
long_description:
Last Accounting Company (LAC) is a full-stack AI accounting firm. We sell the same service (bookkeeping, tax filings, etc.) as a traditional accounting firm, but underneath agents handle everything and a certified accountant signs off. Our service is faster, cheaper, and fully integrated, allowing our clients to focus on what matters, not accounting admin.

LAC replaces both outsourced accountants and legacy accounting software for startups and SMBs. Our system is fully proprietary, from the general ledger to the accounting agents. This allows us to create powerful self-reinforcing loops and ultimately provide a state-of-the-art accounting service.

launches.title: The Last Accounting Company you’ll ever need
launches.tagline: Agent-native accounting firm that replaces the legacy software and the outsourced service.
launches.body:
Hey YC 👋

We’re[ Riki](https://www.linkedin.com/in/riki-karjalainen-22a612189),[ Sami](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sami-laakkonen/),[ Veikko](https://www.linkedin.com/in/veikkopere/), and[ Pietari](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pietarivirkkunen/), the founders of[ Last Accounting Company](https://lastaccountingcompany.com/).

**TL;DR**

**LAC is the agent-native accounting firm. \
AI agents do the work and our (human) accountants validate all outputs.**

We replace both the traditional accounting firm and the legacy accounting software with one end-to-end service. Founders get current books, correct filings, and an always up-to-date general ledger, not another dashboard to operate.

[https://drive.google.com/file/d/100N7xvBREGMXpbgnYOUNAiFqht0Gc3EA](https://drive.google.com/file/d/100N7xvBREGMXpbgnYOUNAiFqht0Gc3EA/view?usp=sharing)

**🗃️ The problem**

Founders didn’t start companies to learn accounting. Yet disconnected systems turn them into the human link between their accountant, bank, payroll, invoices, and internal tools.

They find and forward data, wait for questions, track down missing context, and repeat the cycle. By the time the books are closed, the numbers are often too old to guide day-to-day decisions.

**🛠 Our solution**

LAC connects directly to your bank, payroll, and internal systems. Our agents:

* Keep the general ledger continuously up to date
* Handle bookkeeping, invoices, payroll, and receipts
* Prepare filings according to local requirements
* Surface missing information and potential issues early

Our expert accountants validate the work before anything is filed.

LAC also connects financial data with the tools teams already use, including ERP, CRM, and product analytics. Through our Slack agent or MCP, founders can ask questions like:

* What are our burn and runway?
* How’s our cash flow looking for Q3? Can we afford a new hire?
* Where did spending change this quarter?

**Your books stop being only a filing obligation. They become the ground truth behind every decision.**

Unlike accounting tools built for one task at a time, LAC is one system—from the general ledger to the accounting agents—and we operate the service ourselves.

Customers simply get their accounting done.

**👥 The team**

We’re three technical builders and one finance-and-law brain. Riki and Sami previously built petabyte-scale financial data infrastructure at Token Terminal. Veikko brings experience from BCG, private equity, finance, and law. Pietari brings engineering and sales experience across tech, VC, and PE.

**🙏 Our ask**

Run a startup or SMB in Europe or the US, or know someone who does?\
We’d love to show you what LAC can do! A one-line intro is enough and we’ll take it from there.

Email us at: [hello@lastaccountingcompany.com](mailto:hello@lastaccountingcompany.com)\
Sign up or read more at:[ ](https://lastaccountingcompany.com/)[lastaccountingcompany.com](http://lastaccountingcompany.com)
